narr: Heavy rain fell in southern Goshen County the afternoon of 12 June 2023. Led to flash flooding from Hawk Springs to La Grange.
ev: Observer reported 4 inches of rain over a short period of time. Nearby streams out of their banks including Bear Creek. County roads washed out.
lsr: Received report of flooding on Bear Creek leading to road closures near County Road 25 and Bear Creek Road.
